court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
respondents: Election Commission of India, Rep. by its Director and Another … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Petitioner(s) : Mr. P.V. Balasubramanian Senior Counsel for Mr. K.M.C. Arunmokan
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Tarun Rao Kallakuru
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing Respondent 1 - Election Commission of India and Respondent 2 (Chief Electoral Officer, Puducherry) to permit the candidates set up by the petitioner, who have filed their nominations as independent candidates due to the delayed grant of party registration, to be treated as candidates of the petitioner party for the limited purpose of symbol allotment and consequentially to issue a further direction to the respondents to allot a common symbol to all such candidates under provisions of the Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968 in view of the exceptional and bona fide circumstances arising from the delayed issuance of the Party Registration Certificate and consequentially to direct Respondents 3 to 5 (District Election Officer and Returning Officers concerned) to give effect to such common symbol allotment and not treat the candidates as unrelated independent candidates for the purpose of symbol allocation.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— After arguing for some time, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner sought leave of the court to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to work out the remedy in accordance with law.

2. In view of the said submission, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty. There shall be no order as to costs.
